claim: STEP 1: once-weekly semaglutide 2.4 mg for 68 weeks reduced body weight by a mean of 14.9% vs 2.4% with placebo in adults with overweight or obesity (N=1961).
SUSTAIN-6: in type 2 diabetes at high cardiovascular risk, MACE occurred in 6.6% (semaglutide) vs 8.9% (placebo); HR 0.74 (95% CI 0.58–0.95).
SELECT: in overweight/obesity with cardiovascular disease and no diabetes, MACE in 6.5% vs 8.0%; HR 0.80 (95% CI 0.72–0.90) over a mean 39.8 months.
